Rundeer Off-Road E-Bike Attack 10

Rundeer Off Road E-Bike Attack10

Powerful 1000W Motor - Powerful BAFANG Motor with Flexible Power Control – Equipped with a proven BAFANG motor, the Attack 10 delivers strong, stable power and torque for flat roads, steep climbs, and challenging outdoor terrain. With both throttle and pedal assist, it provides responsive control and a top speed of up to 28 MPH.

SAMSUNG Cells Large Capacity Battery - Samsung 48V 20Ah High-Capacity Battery – The large-capacity Samsung lithium battery delivers up to 80 miles of range on a single charge. It also provides reliable discharge performance, long cycle life, and dependable performance in low-temperature conditions.

Perfect Braking And Shock Absorption - Attack 10 E-bike adopts front and rear disc hydraulic brakes, which can brake the e-bike quickly and fully protect your safety. With 7-speed transmission, you can choose any speed according to your need.

High quality Accessories - Magnesium alloy frame makes the e-bike more lightweight. Lockable suspension fork is durable and lightweight. You can get the speed, battery level, total mileage and power assist level on the LCD display.

Safety Certifications and Quality Assurance– The Attack 10 has passed authoritative certifications, including 2849 and 2271, and is designed to comply with applicable U.S. regulations, including CPSC, GCC, and 16 CFR 1512.

One-Piece Die-Cast Magnesium-Alloy Frame – The integrated die-cast magnesium-alloy frame increases stiffness by approximately 30% compared with traditional welded construction. Magnesium alloy is approximately 35% lighter than aluminum alloy at the same volume and offers excellent vibration-damping performance. The frame supports a maximum load of 350 lbs.

All-Terrain Suspension and Hydraulic Disc Brakes – Wide 20-inch tires provide strong grip and stability on snow, mountains, gravel, dirt, and other challenging surfaces. Dual-shoulder hydraulic suspension absorbs impacts from rough terrain, while dual-piston hydraulic disc brakes deliver fast, stable braking response and improved control.

Premium Components for Reliable Performance – The Attack 10 features a KING-METER color display, a Lishui motor controller, and a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain. The large color display keeps riding information clear and easy to read, while the drivetrain allows flexible gear changes for flat roads, climbs, and changing terrain.
